title: Use a complete collector for pre-definition audits
failure_signature: The inherited-source collision probe imported the new preregistration builder before its x1 definitions module existed and stopped with ModuleNotFoundError.
trigger_preconditions: Read-only audit imported the incomplete new module
candidate_workaround: Run the compatible collector from the complete predecessor builder until the new definitions module exists, then validate the new import explicitly.
recurrence_guard: Preflight local module dependencies before importing a newly scaffolded phase tool.
rollback: No source row or repository artifact was changed by the failed import; retain the failure and rerun only the read-only collector from a complete module.
protected_gates: No inferred audit result from failed imports
scope_boundary: This method addresses local dependency order only and proves no scientific, legal, cultural, security, identity, authority, or independent-reproduction claim.
